Noise suppression models for the microphone, from @sapphi-red/web-noise-suppressor 0.4.1
(MIT, https://github.com/sapphi-red/web-noise-suppressor), copied unchanged except
for the removed source map comments.

  rnnoise-worklet.js, rnnoise.wasm, rnnoise_simd.wasm   xiph/rnnoise (BSD), via shiguredo/rnnoise-wasm
  gtcrn-worklet.js, gtcrn.wasm                          Xiaobin-Rong/gtcrn (MIT), via sapphi-red/gtcrn-wasm

Each worklet file carries its own license headers.
